metadata.title: Gibson Assembly (Isothermal DNA Assembly, NEB Gibson Assembly Master Mix E2611)
metadata.purpose: Join two or more overlapping DNA fragments (inserts + linearized vector) into a single seamless, covalently sealed construct in one isothermal reaction at 50 C, then transform the assembled DNA into E. coli.
metadata.scope: Gibson Assembly using NEB Gibson Assembly Master Mix (E2611) for 2-6 fragments sharing 15-25 nt terminal overlaps, in a 20 uL reaction. Primer/overlap design and downstream colony screening are summarized but not detailed. NEBuilder HiFi (E2621) and long/repeat-rich assemblies may need different conditions.
metadata.estimatedTime: ~1-1.5 h reaction (15-60 min at 50 C) plus fragment prep and transformation
beforeYouBegin: Design primers so adjacent fragments share 15-25 nt overlaps (NEB recommends the NEBuilder web tool).
PCR-amplify fragments and linearize the vector with a high-fidelity polymerase; quantify by agarose gel or NanoDrop.
Compute pmols with pmols = (ng x 1000) / (bp x 650). Use 50-100 ng vector with 2-3 fold molar excess insert (5x excess if insert <200 bp).
Keep total volume of unpurified PCR fragments <=20% of the reaction; column-purify when assembling >=3 fragments or fragments >5 kb.
Set the reaction up on ice.

materials.name: Gibson Assembly Master Mix (2X)
materials.specification: Single-buffer mix of a 5' exonuclease (creates 3' overhangs), a high-fidelity DNA polymerase (fills gaps), and Taq DNA ligase (seals nicks)
materials.rawText: Gibson Assembly Master Mix (2X): 10 ul per 20 ul reaction

sourceReferences.excerpt: The Gibson Assembly Master Mix includes three different enzymatic activities ... exonuclease ... DNA polymerase ... DNA ligase.

materials.name: Linearized vector (backbone)
materials.specification: PCR-amplified or restriction-linearized; 50-100 ng per reaction
materials.rawText: Optimized cloning efficiency is 50-100 ng of vectors with 2-3 fold of excess inserts.

materials.name: DNA insert fragment(s)
materials.workingConcentration: 2-3 fold molar excess over vector (5x if <200 bp)
materials.specification: PCR products with 15-25 nt overlaps to adjacent fragments; for >=3 fragments use equimolar ratios
materials.rawText: concentration of assembly fragments should be 2-3 times higher than the concentration of vector. Use 5 times more of inserts if size is less than 200 bps.

materials.name: Deionized H2O
materials.specification: Milli-Q or equivalent; brings reaction to final volume

materials.name: Positive control DNA
materials.specification: Control fragments supplied with the kit; control reagents provided for 5 experiments
materials.rawText: Positive Control: Total Amount of Fragments 10 ul; Control reagents are provided for 5 experiments.

materials.name: Competent E. coli (e.g. NEB 5-alpha)
materials.specification: Chemically competent or electrocompetent cells for transformation of the assembled product
materials.rawText: Transform into E. coli or use directly in other applications.

materials.name: High-fidelity DNA polymerase
materials.specification: For PCR amplification of fragments and linearization of the vector
materials.rawText: PCR amplify fragments using a high-fidelity DNA polymerase.

equipment.name: Thermocycler
equipment.settings: 50 C; 15 min (2-3 fragments) or 60 min (4-6 fragments)

equipment.name: Agarose gel electrophoresis rig / NanoDrop spectrophotometer
equipment.settings: Fragment and vector QC and quantitation (A260)

samples.description: dsDNA fragments with 15-25 nt terminal overlaps to adjacent pieces

samples.name: Linearized vector
samples.description: Backbone with overlaps to the terminal fragments

samples.name: Assembled construct

tables.title: Gibson Assembly reaction setup (set up on ice)
tables.note: Recommended DNA: 0.02-0.5 pmol total for 1-2 fragments into a vector; 0.2-1.0 pmol total for 4-6 fragments. If more than 6 fragments, additional master mix may be needed.

steps.action: Design primers so adjacent fragments (and the vector) share 15-25 nt overlapping sequences.
steps.criticalNotes: NEB recommends the NEBuilder web tool for overlap/primer design.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Design primers to amplify fragments (and/or vector) with appropriate overlaps.

steps.action: PCR-amplify the fragments and prepare the linearized vector (by PCR or restriction digestion) with a high-fidelity DNA polymerase.

sourceReferences.excerpt: PCR amplify fragments using a high-fidelity DNA polymerase. Prepare linearized vector ...

steps.action: Confirm and quantify fragments and linearized vector by agarose gel electrophoresis and/or NanoDrop; compute pmols.

parameters.rawText: pmols = (weight in ng) x 1,000 / (base pairs x 650 daltons)

steps.criticalNotes: 50 ng of 5000 bp dsDNA ~ 0.015 pmol; 50 ng of 500 bp dsDNA ~ 0.15 pmol.

steps.action: On ice, combine DNA fragments + linearized vector, 10 uL Gibson Assembly Master Mix (2X), and deionized H2O to a 20 uL total per the reaction table. Use 0.02-0.5 pmol total DNA for 2-3 fragments (0.2-1.0 pmol for 4-6).

parameters.rawText: Total Amount of Fragments: 0.02-0.5 pmol (2-3 fragment assembly)

steps.criticalNotes: Keep unpurified PCR fragment volume <=20% of the reaction. Set the reaction up on ice.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Set up the following reaction on ice: ... Gibson Assembly Master Mix (2X) 10 ul ... Total Volume 20 ul.

steps.action: (Optional) Set up the positive control: 10 uL control DNA + 10 uL Gibson Assembly Master Mix (2X), no water, 20 uL total.

parameters.rawText: Positive Control: Total Amount of Fragments 10 ul; Master Mix 10 ul; H2O 0

steps.action: Incubate in a thermocycler at 50 C: 15 min for 2-3 fragments, or 60 min for 4-6 fragments.

parameters.rawText: 50 C for 15 minutes (2-3 fragments) to 60 minutes (4-6 fragments)

steps.criticalNotes: Extended incubation up to 60 min may improve efficiency in some cases.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Incubate samples in a thermocycler at 50 C for 15 minutes when 2 or 3 fragments are being assembled or 60 minutes when 4-6 fragments are being assembled.

steps.action: Store samples on ice or at -20 C for subsequent transformation.

parameters.rawText: Store samples on ice or at -20 C

sourceReferences.excerpt: Store samples on ice or at -20 C for subsequent transformation.

steps.action: Transform the assembled product into competent E. coli. For electroporation, dilute the reaction 3-fold and use 1 uL.
steps.criticalNotes: For chemical transformation NEB recommends ~2 uL of the assembly into 50 uL competent cells (e.g. NEB 5-alpha); exact volume not stated in this source.

sourceReferences.excerpt: When using ... for electroporation, it is necessary to dilute the reaction 3-fold and use 1 ul for transformation.

controls.name: Positive control
controls.description: Kit-supplied control fragments assembled in parallel to confirm reagents and thermocycling are working.

controls.name: Vector-only (no-insert) background control
controls.description: Linearized vector processed without inserts; high colony counts indicate uncut/recircularized vector background.

expectedOutputs: A double-stranded, fully sealed assembled DNA molecule usable directly for transformation, PCR, or RCA.
Transformant colonies carrying the intended construct, confirmed by colony PCR and/or sequencing.

troubleshooting.cause: Low-competence cells; too little/too much DNA; poor overlaps
troubleshooting.solution: Use higher-efficiency cells; keep 0.02-0.5 pmol (2-3 frag); verify 15-25 nt overlaps and correct pmol ratios
Ensure complete vector linearization; run a vector-only control

troubleshooting.cause: Elevated PCR carryover or fragment number
troubleshooting.solution: Column-purify PCR products; keep fragment volume <=20%; extend incubation toward 60 min

safety: If ethidium bromide or other DNA stains are used for gel QC, handle as mutagens per institutional rules.
Handle the E. coli cloning host per institutional biosafety guidelines.
limitations: Optimized for 2-6 fragments with 15-25 nt overlaps; efficiency drops as fragment number/length increases. Chemical-transformation volume and antibiotic selection/plating details are protein/vector-specific and not fixed here.
